name: Popover
summary: Anchor a floating panel of rich content to a trigger.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-popover> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. A click on the slotted trigger toggles the `open` attribute on a persistent panel (never rebuilt), so opacity and lift animate. Richer than a Tooltip — it holds interactive content. Zero drift.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: [slot=trigger]
props.desc: The element that toggles the panel

whenToUse.when: a small panel of rich or interactive content anchored to a control
a short, non-interactive hint on hover
a focused task that should block the rest of the page

opinion.note: Trigger on click for interactive content (Tooltip owns hover). Close on outside-click and Escape — both are built in. Keep the panel content short; a long form belongs in a Modal.
opinion.dsv3: White elevated surface with the standard 8 radius and a soft ink shadow. Fade + 4px lift via the shared motion tokens on a persistent panel — no subtree rebuild on open/close.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step. The fast path for vibe-coding.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe is open so the panel is laid out.
